FEATURED TECHNICAL WORK SAMPLE | LOCAL AI ON ANDROID
RunAnywhere Flutter starter — Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M on TECNO KM6 / Android CPU	Nov 2026

• Investigated blank and delayed outputs in a local-model chat flow. Traced the original Fast-mode control issue to native template integration and prepared a local candidate patch forwarding the mode through Jinja-capable template rendering, with stream classification and token-accounting corrections. Narrow native checks and user-run Flutter checks passed; it is not merged upstream.

• The post-patch joke capture remained blank: 1,024 output tokens over 116.504 seconds, zero answer characters, and finish reason `length`. The app-selected total output allowance was exhausted; this does not prove another native defect.

• User-supplied Flutter debug logs for one arithmetic prompt showed Fast at 1.981 s / 1 output token and Reasoning at 96.867 s / 844 tokens; both displayed “4”. Reasoning appeared at 1.597 s, but answer text arrived at 96.860 s. This is a mode comparison, not an engine speedup.

• The app selects 256 output tokens for Fast and 1,024 for Reasoning; native decoding enforces the total allowance. Thinking can consume it before an answer appears. This is a local resource limit, not a per-token API bill.

• A separate native budget pilot showed the trade-off: a 32-token arithmetic cap took 5.022 s but gave a wrong answer; a 32-token discount run took 99.273 s and remained unfinished. The prototype was not deployed to Flutter.

Methods and limits: Android CPU only, one phone/model quantization; the Flutter timings are user-supplied debug-run evidence and the installed binary hash was not verified. Native and Flutter harnesses are separate. No NPU result or controlled benchmark is claimed. Investigation and development were AI-assisted.
